description: This file defines the DisplayFieldGroup entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the database table 'ohrm_display_field_group' and including properties such as id, reportGroup, name, isList, and selectedDisplayFieldGroups with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DisplayFieldGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a display field group with properties for id, report group, name, list status, and related selected display fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the display field group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the display field group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the display field group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the display field group.

methods.name: isList
methods.description: Checks if the display field group is listed.

methods.name: setIsList
methods.description: Sets the list status of the display field group.
